slides.heading: Logical NOT
slides.body: Logical NOT is part of Boolean Logic and Comparisons. This short lesson gives you a practical Python idea you can understand, try, and reuse in simple programs.

slides.heading: Core Idea: Logical NOT
slides.body: The not operator reverses a boolean value. True becomes False, and False becomes True.

slides.heading: Real-World Analogy
slides.body: not is like flipping a yes/no answer to its opposite.

slides.heading: Key Rule
slides.body: Boolean expressions must produce True or False. Use comparisons and logical operators carefully.
